name: ACP
description: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) host mode: run minimal-agent as an ACP agent over stdio, so editors (Zed, JetBrains, others) can drive it with no custom glue. Level 1: initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel, session/set_config_option (model, effort), text/thought streaming, tool-call, usage and notice updates, ACP stop-reason mapping, and an opt-in approval gate (session/request_permission, off by default, --approval to turn on).

hostModes.description: Agent Client Protocol v1 over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0 / NDJSON).
